failure: Failure: The equal-marginal correlation distribution is one feasible construction, not a unique source history. The interval bound applies only to the cited organic-material source class, not every historical carbon-bearing phase; extreme reservoirs remain possible but unconnected to the amino acid. The central mechanism of mixing-induced isotope clumping is acknowledged as known prior art. No β-alanine origin or chirality mechanism is established.
interface: Interface: All probability equations refer to corrected native carbon probabilities. The source uses the displayed VPDB-ratio-to-probability interface, but applying that correction to this pair model is unverified. A derivatization reagent adds carbon, so native double-substitution ratios require the stated generating-polynomial deconvolution. Two 13C substitutions and one 18O substitution are separated by only 0.00246468 Da; calibrated line shapes, standards and integration are needed.

claims.title: Beta-alanine isotope-pair data admit an exact correlation inversion and a sharp source-range bound
